items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Yeah, no, I don't remember those guys.

ctx.x: See, another day that I remember, Walter Brundy and the Zeno, while old man Contrell and now let's see, I can remember. Old timers. No, that's... Remember Mac Murray? No, I don't, no. I've heard of him, but I don't remember him.
Yeah, no, I don't remember those guys. Ever before your time? Yeah, they were for mine, because the first time I ever heard Buddy Bowling play, I was a youngster. I went out to Lincoln Park.
